snippets_slug_canonical.name: snippets_slug_canonical
snippets_slug_canonical.value: "snippets"."slug" <> '' AND "snippets"."slug" = lower("snippets"."slug") AND "snippets"."slug" NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9-]*' AND "snippets"."slug" NOT GLOB '-*' AND "snippets"."slug" NOT GLOB '*-' AND "snippets"."slug" NOT GLOB '*--*'

snippets_archive_consistent.name: snippets_archive_consistent
snippets_archive_consistent.value: ("snippets"."status" = 'archived' AND "snippets"."archived_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("snippets"."status" = 'active' AND "snippets"."archived_at" IS NULL)
